map.：测得 MIC 0.06 mg/L，对照 EUCAST 大肠杆敏感折点（≤1）判: : measured MIC 0.06 mg/L against the EUCAST susceptible breakpoint for E. coli (<=1) reads S; if the MIC is 8, then >=2 reads R and the regimen must change.
map.便隐血(OB)试纸判读器: Fecal occult blood (OB) test strip interpreter
map.S 就一定有效吗？: Does S always mean it works?
map.不一定，还需看感染部位浓度、患者免疫与 PK/PD；折点是群体概率，非个体保证。: Not necessarily; you also need the concentration at the infection site, patient immunity and PK/PD; a breakpoint is a population probability, not an individual guarantee.
map.CLSI 和 EUCAST 一样吗？: Are CLSI and EUCAST the same?
map.有差异，同一 MIC 可能判读不同，报告应注明采用标准。: There are differences; the same MIC may be read differently, so reports should state which standard was used.
map.能直接选抗生素吗？: Can I pick an antibiotic directly?
map.不能，经验性/目标性用药由医师与临床药师综合决定，本工具仅做折点对照。: No; empirical or targeted therapy is decided by the physician together with the clinical pharmacist, and this tool only checks the breakpoint.
